vulnerability_behavior.specific_code_behavior_causing_vulnerabi: The code uses kmalloc to allocate memory for the command buffer, which does not initialize the allocated memory. This uninitialized memory could contain sensitive data from previous allocations or other processes.

vul_knowledge.solution_behavior: To mitigate the vulnerability, it is necessary to initialize the allocated memory before using it. This can be achieved by replacing kmalloc with kzalloc, which allocates and zeroes out the memory. This ensures that any data exposed to user space will be initialized to zero, preventing information leakage.
